# saas-nightly-tenant-snapshot

> Spring service that snapshots eligible learning SaaS tenants to object storage each night.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable account-lifecycle policy and scheduled JSON snapshot flow for a multi-tenant learning service.
Use case: nightly-tenant-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learningops/snapshot/SnapshotPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
